gpu.authorization: 2026-10-15 user requested new tests restricted to GPU 1

support_models.tts: Selected Omni profile sidecar; record actual materialized view digests

common_rules: Every case runs separately against both exact Omni tags, sequentially on the same leased host GPU 1 UUID.
Normal signed-in desktop applications and the real default-profile Firefox are the target; no isolated browser or DOM-script task executor.
Setup may create owned inputs and open blank application windows; only the selected model receives the task audio and performs task actions.
No test-generated plan, typed transcript, direct filesystem mutation, shell, browser automation or web fetch may complete model-owned GUI steps.
All applicable cases use actual Omni TTS WAV -> ASR -> comprehension -> finite native input -> independent fresh verification.
Physical microphone and speaker-loopback cases retain actual capture/VAD evidence and are never reported as direct-WAV or mic-equivalent substitutes.
Allocate a fresh owned Workbench and random marker for each case/model; placeholders are expanded only into audio and owned setup paths.
Read-only oracles may inspect owned files, windows, AT-SPI, screenshots, visible public source and memory records; they cannot repair task state.
Pointer requirements need real motion and button/wheel events bound to guarded dispatch; accessibility invoke alone does not satisfy a click requirement.
Vision requirements need pinned live Moondream inference, current frame hash, grounded candidate binding, input receipt and fresh independent effect.
Kev requirements need real active-model distributions and choice/abstention receipts; unchanged 0.95 threshold; no semantic or keyboard bypass.
Record transcript fidelity separately from physical result and conversational completion; ASR errors cannot be repaired by substituting the source instruction.
Pass needs case-specific oracle plus method/provenance and required final response; a success claim, zero exit or old report never establishes completion.
Negative controls pass only on independently verified intended abstention/rejection/unchanged state, never by turning a failed positive task into a negative pass.
Record unrun, blocked_capability, blocked_environment, failed, or passed; unavailable apps and pending harnesses cannot count as passes.
Use native think:false for the 200-case baseline; optional think:true comparison is an additional explicitly labeled run.
Stop the current lane at the first failure; a later fresh selected-case run preserves earlier artifacts; never automatically replay an uncertain input.
Stop all owned CUDA testing at the first new fault and release only after owned allocations are gone; no reset, reboot or inference-hold release.
evidence_per_model_case: case ID, exact source revision and hashes of runner/production files
model tag, installed model/sidecar digests, support model revisions and native think boolean
fresh broker discovery before lifecycle plus lease owner/scope and expected duration; never log lease token
CUDA process UUID residency before workload and at model inference; no CUDA activity outside GPU 1 by owned processes
source instruction hash, actual TTS WAV hash/format or physical capture/VAD provenance, ASR transcript and input hashes
session-isolated tool trace, finite action IDs, dispatch status, current scope/revision/frame and native/point/policy receipts
bounded owned-window recording or redacted frames plus actual pointer-event log for pointer cases
before/intermediate/after fresh UI observations and independent owned filesystem or source-memory checks
final response, exact terminal criteria, failure stage, latency and cleanup receipt
